lines.text: Many learners say: Please explain me the rule.
Better: Please explain the rule to me.
The rule to me! Please explain the rule to me.

data.right: Please explain the rule to me.
data.memory: Please explain the rule to me.

native.tip: Kita bilang “jelaskan ke saya”, jadi sering langsung explain me. Di bahasa Inggris, sebut hal yang dijelaskan dulu, lalu to me.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “Please explain me the rule.” 😅 Setelah explain, sebut hal yang dijelaskan dulu, lalu to me: “Please explain the rule to me.” Dengarkan Kak Ama, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “the rule to me”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “Please explain the rule to me.” lalu tulis satu kalimat dengan explain … to me. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “jelaskan ke saya”, so we often say explain me. In English, say the thing first, then to me.
en.caption: Ever say this? “Please explain me the rule.” 😅 After explain, say the thing first, then to me: “Please explain the rule to me.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
